waypoints.name: SR-20 Hairpin / Pond Pullout (east of Washington Pass)
waypoints.note: Pullout at the SR-20 hairpin east of Washington Pass; walk back toward the pass to the pond where the East Face climbers' path starts.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 (North Cascades Highway) to Washington Pass and continue east down from the pass to the big hairpin turn below Liberty Bell's East Face, at about 5,200 ft; coming from Winthrop it is the hairpin just before the final climb to the pass. Park on the shoulder at the curve, then walk back up the road toward the pass to a small pond on the south side, where the climbers' path starts at its east end. SR-20 is closed over the pass in winter.
